configurePresets.name: Debug
configurePresets.description: Sanitized host build with warnings as errors. The default; what CI runs.

configurePresets.name: Shipped
configurePresets.description: The optimisation level the firmware actually ships: -O2, no sanitizer. The Debug preset builds at -O1 under ASan, so it is the one configuration that cannot answer 'does -O2 move any number?' - which is one of the four causes the fixture's header tells a reader to suspect.
